answer: One walnut per identity: each key splits a walnut on the roll and seals a 30 POA pearl inside as its stake; weight holds only while it sits whole. Each epoch the roll breathes a fresh zephyr; the key signs it onto its walnut within 45 seconds. Lottery graders replay one walnut in six per epoch, re-checking every seal. A missed, forged, or shared zephyr burns the pearl: 30 POA destroyed, weight zeroed, key benched two epochs. Fakes pay per head: N fakes × 30 POA = 30N POA burned. Limit: honest keys stake the same.
